title: Strictness after sealing
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. If every gate of $C$ has distinct arguments and has one argument when it is a NOT gate and two otherwise, then the sealed circuit has those same gate properties, and every vertex other than its output is read by at least one gate.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit with $n$ inputs, gates in topological order, and a valid designated output
Every gate of $C$ has distinct arguments
Each NOT gate has exactly one argument and each other gate exactly two arguments
